name: Kolom
line: every Mac window in a column of one scrolling strip
question: What if your Mac's windows lined up in a strip you could swipe through, and you could ask for a layout in plain words?
body: A native macOS tiling window manager: real windows in columns of a sideways-scrolling strip, one strip per display, stacks of up to three, and a rail with live CPU, memory and network. A display staircase keeps columns sliding cleanly off every edge between monitors. Press ⌥K and type "3×2 terminals on screen 2": Apple's on-device model turns it into one checked action, with nothing leaving the Mac. Agent-ready through kolomctl and MCP, and pause, quit or a crash puts every window back.
